title: Triton Bidder Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Triton bidder: the Triton station and dsp-service ad tag of a placement, plus the per-placement settings of the two paths (banner via dsp-service RTB, audio/video via a VAST wrapper to dsp-service's VAST endpoint).

stid.description: Triton station id (placement id on Triton's side), sent to dsp-service in ext.cxr and to Triton as stid

tagId.description: dsp-service ad tag id of the placement, used as the {tag} path segment of the RTB endpoint

brandId.description: dsp-service brand id of the ad tag, used as the {brand} path segment and ext.cxr.brand_id when it differs from the Prebid Server account (publisher id); defaults to the publisher id

hostRender.description: banner: render mode; server = dsp-service finishes the creative (default), client = dsp-service hands the device a boot creative (ext.cxr.pa = 1)

cpm.description: audio/video: the price the Triton wrapper bid competes at (CPM, USD); defaults to 0.05
